channel.title: VISIONE Wire
channel.description: Global news, gaming, entertainment, business, markets, technology, artificial intelligence, policy and culture from VISIONE Wire.

item.title: NASA Roman Space Telescope successfully launches: 3-month journey to L2 begins
item.description: Updated: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope successfully launched on Falcon Heavy, separated from the rocket, deployed its solar panels and began its three-month journey toward Sun-Earth L2.

item.title: Xbox turns supported game discs into digital entitlements: how the August 31 test works
item.description: Microsoft is testing a disc-to-digital entitlement feature for thousands of supported Xbox One and Xbox Series X games from August 31.

item.title: PlayStation ends physical game discs in 2028: what the policy actually changes
item.description: Sony will stop producing physical discs for new PlayStation game releases from January 2028, while existing disc releases remain unaffected.

item.title: Fable gameplay reveals Bowerstone, buyable homes and February 23, 2027 release
item.description: Playground Games' new quest walkthrough shows Bowerstone, enterable buildings, property ownership, choice and consequence, and style-weaving combat.

item.title: OpenAI plans to cut off Cursor model access on November 12 after SpaceX takeover
item.description: OpenAI is winding down its model-supply agreement after Cursor changed hands, while developers retain several routes to keep using OpenAI models inside the editor.

item.title: Gamescom Award 2026 winners: Witcher 3 and Sega take three awards each
item.description: CD Projekt Red's Witcher 3 presence and Sega's lineup lead the official 19-category results, while Onimusha and Ubisoft take two awards each.

item.title: Gamescom 2026 Opening Night Live: Witcher 3 Remastered, Songs of the Past and biggest reveals
item.description: Updated August 26: The Witcher 3 Remastered launches September 29 as a free upgrade, while Songs of the Past reveals Letten, Switch 2 support and a 2027 release window.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4 beta: new movement, maps and open beta dates
item.description: Infinity Ward is testing a faster, more fluid version of grounded Call of Duty multiplayer before the public open beta begins August 28.
